r.name: Way of the Roses Cycle Route
Aislabie Walk
r.description: Circular route between Studley Royal and Hackfall woods

r.name: Circular Walk at Brimham Rocks
r.description: This short circular shows Brimham's highlights - from the dramatic rock formations to moorland. Sloping paths with slight incline, steps & steep drops. Not suitable for mobility scooters, prams or wheelchairs due to gradients, uneven & narrow terrain.

r.name: Brimham Rocks to Pateley Bridge Circular Walk, Brimham Rocks
r.description: This circular walk takes you from dramatic moorland rock formations by the River Nidd to Pateley Bridge, returning via the Nidderdale Way, an area of outstanding natural beauty.

r.name: Farmland, Big Skies and Birds of Prey Walk, Brimham Rocks
r.description: A gentle walk through farms, meadows and pastures, with wide open spaces & a great chance of spotting birds of prey like red kites, buzzards and kestrels. Mainly flat on paved, farm tracks & through fields. Includes muddy parts, stiles, steps and gates.

r.name: Fields and Fell Beck trail from Brimham Rocks
r.description: A gentle, easy walk through meadows, pastures & woodland to Fell Beck. Meander back to the Brimham Rocks visitor centre, take in views across the countryside & marvel at rock formations like Idol Rock & the Dancing Bear. Stiles, gates & steep sections.

r.name: Moorland and meadows walk at Brimham Rocks
r.description: Explore the diverse landscapes around Brimham Rocks, home to a range of pondlife, wild cotton and waist-high bracken. The walk culminates with stunning views across the Yorkshire Moors, and on a clear day you might even catch a glimpse of York Minster.

r.name: Fountains Abbey Ancient Trees Walk
r.description: On this circular walk you'll learn a little more about the ancient trees in the Deer Park and gain insights into 18th-century landscaping. Mix of loose stone, grass & paved paths with some steep gradients - not suitable for wheelchairs & mobility scooters

r.name: Long Powered Mobility Vehicle Route, Fountains Abbey
r.description: 5 mobility scooters & 4 wheelchairs are available to hire, free of charge, at NT's Fountains Abbey. Book in advance on 01765 608888 and collect your mobility scooter or wheelchair from the West Gate entrance between 10.30am and 11.30am.

r.name: Pastures and Panoramas Walk at Brimham Rocks
r.description: Pass through pastures in Nidderdale with panoramic views across the dale and beyond, on this circular walk. As you walk along the river path, you might see flashes of blue as kingfishers fly past, or brown trout in the river. Muddy in places.

r.name: Brimham Rocks Boundary Walk
r.description: Enjoy a circular walk around the boundary of Brimham Rocks & discover panoramic views of the Yorkshire countryside. Pass through woodland, farmland & open moorland, and glimpse at the rock formations that give Brimham Rocks their name along the way.

r.name: Monks' Walk from Brimham Rocks to Fountains Abbey
r.description: Starting at Brimham Rocks, follow the footsteps of the Cistercian monks on this ancient trail leading you to Fountains Abbey. Along the way, you'll be met with expansive views from Riva Hill to Brimham Rocks. Uneven & one short steep ascent via steps

r.name: Fountains Abbey Estate Boundary Walk
r.description: Walk around the boundary of Fountains Abbey & Studley Royal, with some of the best views of the estate to enjoy. After taking in the hall & deer park, walk through the 18th-century water garden & past the Abbey. Steps, steep gradients and bridges present.

r.name: The Seven Bridges Valley Walk, Fountains Abbey
r.description: Take this circular walk to see a more rustic & beautiful side of the estate. Starting at the Lake outfall, this walk follows the meandering Skell river along the steep-sided valley via a series of delightful arched bridges, of which only five remain.

r.name: Skell Valley Explorer, Fountains Abbey
r.description: Enjoy a countryside walk around Grantley & Sawley featuring Spa Gill Woods & Eavestone Lake. This walk can be split into two shorter loops; the longer High Grantley loop & the shorter Sawley loop. Please be aware that there may be livestock in fields.

r.name: Studley Royal Deer Park Walk, Fountains Abbey
r.description: Our deer ranger has picked this circular walk as one of his favourites within the Studley Royal deer park. Look out for some of the 300 wild deer that live there. Mostly flat parkland, some uneven ground, with height drops & deep running water.

r.name: Ripon to Fountains Abbey Walk, Fountains Abbey
r.description: A rewarding way to arrive at Fountains Abbey on foot, via rural paths from Ripon & the stately lime avenue through Studley Royal Deer Park. After taking in views of the water garden & Ripon Cathedral, the return via the Seven Bridges Valley.

r.name: The Lost Spa Trail at Fountains Abbey
r.description: Enjoy a walk along the tranquil banks of the River Skell and into the site of a former spa. Return through the pretty village of Aldfield, the deer.

r.name: Studley Park, Water Gardens and Fountains Abbey Walk
r.description: Learn more about the 18th-century landscape of the Deer Park and the Seven Bridges Valley on this 5-mile circular walk at Fountains Abbey and Studley Royal Water Garden, a World Heritage Site. Fairly easy walking although there are a few moderate hills.

r.name: Walk through the centuries at Fountains Abbey
r.description: Walk through the Fountains Abbey & Studley Royal Estate, exploring the abbey, water features & formal, picturesque gardens that mark significant stages in the estate's history over eight centuries from 1132 to 1987. Moderate hills & seasonally muddy.
